The grammar lists it as a rejected example ({"input": "[2021] FedCFamC2A 1", "groups": null}), not a court; the Federal Circuit and Family Court of Australia's medium neutral codes are FedCFamC1A, FedCFamC1F, FedCFamC2F and FedCFamC2G.

Pinpointer's pattern is Carswell[A-Za-z]*, a family of database codes; the registry's reporter carswell holds them (CarswellNat, CarswellOnt, CarswellBC, ...), read as 4:database:carswellont:2005:1234.
A CanLII number is its own citation form (2010 CanLII 1234 reads as 4:canlii:2010:1234), not a reporter or court name.
No digest of that name: absent from the McGill inventory and from all 144,728 aliases; the Westlaw digests the list names beside it (ACWS, AWLD, BCWLD, WDFL, WCB) are registry reporters.

The citator lists OIC with BC Reg and Alta Reg as a regulation prefix of no jurisdiction; orders in council are written OIC by more than one jurisdiction (Yukon's are the series YOIC), so no one series is OIC. It reads as 4:regulation:-:oic:2019:123.
